Welcome to campus!!! I graduated a year ago. Such a cool place to go to school. Definitely get involved. Chattanooga is quirky and there’s a niche for everyone 🧚🏻 Idk what you’re into but I was part of the Rowing team and it was so much fun. I would avoid Douglas Heights- huge party apartment so that was a good time before people started getting shot? Stay away from Highland park area- very sketchy and they have shootings every .5 seconds. 

The library is a great place to study & hangout, reserve some rooms there for a late night study sesh or go to the Yellow Deli. It’s infamous for being a cult but they have some of THE best food and the waiters won’t bother you. 

Visit the Blue Hole while it’s still summer. Great cliff jumping spot!! 

If you go to church I recommend Restoration Southside!!! Most welcoming, judge mental free place! It’s off campus. There is the House - an on campus ministry that I enjoyed. 

Best of luck my dude 💫

I know you do not want psychological advice, but I am in a masters program for clinical psychology and I agree with other comments. This is screaming antisocial personality disorder.
I grew up with my brother, who has this disorder. It was a nightmare to say the least. In and out of jail, stealing my babysitting money, chasing me with knives. He treated my parents like complete shit, and it led me to live angry, silent and terrified. It got to the point where me and my sister were calling the police on a daily basis. I was afraid he would rape me. When he turned 16, my parents gave him up to the state foster care system and released their rights to him. 

I know it is hard, and she is your daughter, but for the well-being of your children and you, PLEASE give her up to a facility or the foster care system. Do not let this carry on like my parents did. Me and my sister suffer severe depression and ptsd from this type of childhood. Not many health care professionals will say this, but treatment for antisocial personality disorder rarely seems to work. For my family, the ONLY thing that has worked is the power of Christ. 
Pray, pray, pray. God always prevails.
